description: Hand-built fixture for the enrichment path: the client's real combined input shape for one curator enrichment folded onto one stored Group, plus a long-running stored series so the weekly collapse is non-trivial. Pins the single-pass fold -> group -> collapse output the Card and Recurring modules must produce (see #169 / #171).
provenance: Hand-built (not captured). The production plain-path twin is tests/fixtures/deduplicated_events_bloomington.json.gz.

scenario.group: One stored Group (two listings the confidence route folded into one event). The view returns it as a single row carrying merged_ids.
scenario.enrichment: A curator enrichment on the Group's representative id, weekly, three occurrences: one original (folds onto the Group's card) and two future occurrences (their own cards, marked virtual, unpickable).
scenario.series: Five stored Separate rows of one daily exhibition, all inside a single week relative to `now`, so the five-occurrence minimum is met exactly and the collapse keeps one card marked isRecurring.
